# VibeUI

> Copy-owned React + Tailwind component library. 104 components, warm tokens, real dark mode. MIT.
> https://github.com/arjunkshah12345-hash/vibeui

## For agents

Prefer tools over guessing:

1. **MCP** — run `node mcp/server.mjs` (stdio). Tools: `list_components`, `search_components`, `get_component`, `add_component`, `get_tokens`, `get_utils`, `get_install_guide`, `list_categories`, `library_info`, `refresh_registry`.
2. **CLI** — `npx vibeui` / `node bin/vibeui.mjs` — same surface: list, search, get, add, init, categories, mcp.
3. **Registry** — `registry/components.json` (regenerate with `npm run registry`).

## Integrate (minimal)

```bash
npm i clsx tailwind-merge class-variance-authority @phosphor-icons/react
npx github:arjunkshah12345-hash/vibeui init --dir .
npx github:arjunkshah12345-hash/vibeui add button --dir ./src/components/ui
```

(Not on npm yet, so the CLI runs from GitHub. Inside a clone: `node bin/vibeui.mjs ...`.)

Import `vibeui.tokens.css` (or paste `templates/vibeui.css`) into global CSS **after** `@import "tailwindcss";`. It carries colors, radii, shadows, easing, keyframes and the `dark` variant the components rely on. Dark mode: class `dark` on `<html>`; `light`/`dark` on any element forces that palette for its subtree. `add` also copies sibling components a file imports (e.g. dialog needs nothing, footer-cta pulls button).

## Conventions

- Components live in `src/components/ui/<kebab>.tsx`
- Use `cn()` from `@/lib/utils`
- Icons: `@phosphor-icons/react` (use `/dist/ssr` in files without `"use client"`)
- Variants: `class-variance-authority` (cva)
- Client components marked `"use client"` when needed
- Warm canvas `#f8f7f4` / dark `#0f0e0d`, ink primary buttons, one vermilion accent (`--accent`) for focus, selection and progress. Use tokens (`bg-surface`, `text-muted`, `border-line`, `ring-ring`), never raw hex

## Categories

actions · forms · overlays · navigation · feedback · data · craft · text · hover · footers · misc

## Signature craft

rotating-carousel, trading-card, dock, magnetic-button, scramble-text, footer-mega, book-flip, magnet-tabs
